body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Entrace Technology introduced a clock-like dual screen device ''Widget Station'' during 2007 CES Unveiled.

On one screen it displays time and weather forecasts in black & white while on the other color LCD provides all kinds of contents including news, stock, and streaming internet radio directly from PC, internet, WiFi and Ethernet.
It is expected to be available on market this May or June.
Not a word on pricing yet.
